_comment: Per-route payload ledger. Enforced by scripts/check-route-budget.mjs in the docs build (blocking in CI via docs-build). Fails when a route EXCEEDS its budget and when it drops far enough below that the budget has gone stale — see that script's header, and engineering/decisions/2026-08-17-studio-dynamic-loading-audit.md §9.7. COVERS ALL FIVE ROUTES perf-nightly.yml measures, as of 2026-09-05: the three content routes joined when `script-size` was deleted from that nightly for measuring what happened to LOAD rather than what the build produced (35% of 150 repeat readings of an IDENTICAL commit moved past its own 3% tolerance, worst 106KB on a ~200KB page). See engineering/decisions/2026-09-02-alarm-channel-saturation.md.
_units: bytes. eagerJsGz = gzip(level 6) of every /_astro/*.js referenced in the route's HTML. htmlRaw = the HTML document itself. Budgets USUALLY carry ~3% headroom above the measured build — the `studio` route deliberately does not, and its _eagerJsGzNote says why: at this route's weight 3% is ~20KB of silent headroom on the one route this ledger exists to watch. Read the per-route note before assuming the convention; the gate also fails if a route drops more than 5% BELOW its budget, which means the number here is stale and must be ratcheted down.

studio._eagerJsGzNote: 705950 -> 708200 (2026-09-24): the six-marker state grammar (PR #2327), and the deck LINTER that tells an old deck its `[ ]` changed meaning is bundled eagerly on this route. MEASURED AS A PAIR on one tree, same machine, same toolchain, same node_modules, root bundles and the docs build rerun for each reading: origin/main f2949b1 (after #2336 and #2343) = 704,846 bytes gz, 89 chunks; this branch rebased onto it = 707,085 (+2,239), chunk count unchanged. #2327 raised this field on three earlier bases (+1,839, +1,847, +2,244); each time `main` raised the same field underneath it, so those raises were dropped in the rebase and this one is set on the MERGED tree. Attributed at the source: authoring-core carries rule 16 `moved-empty-box` and the advice it gives per layout, the slide-scoped rewrite in `applyFix` that `lint:deck --fix` and the Studio's Fix all share, the `[!]`/`[?]` rows in the typed-glyph table (together about +1,789 on the first pair), and `headingSubSlides` (+384), the line mirror of the heading split that keeps the rewrite on the slide it judged: the default split puts several slides in one `---` chunk, and an independent checker saw a chunk-wide rewrite reach a neighboring checklist. The rest is a +90 net icon swap in the Compose table picker (arrow-right-to-line out, circle-question-mark in for `[?]`). NOT GIVEN BACK: rule 16 is the only channel that tells an author their verdict-grid, pricing or obligation-matrix `[ ]` now draws something else, and without it an unmigrated deck renders with a different meaning and exits 0. Trimming its prose was not tried, on the evidence recorded below: a 958-character prose cut moved this route by five bytes. SET TIGHT, matching the entries below: 707,085 plus ~1.1KB. PRIOR: 701500 -> 705950 (2026-09-24): portable packages (PR #2336). MEASURED AS A PAIR on one machine, root bundles and docs fully rebuilt for each reading: origin/main b92a6b5 = 700,436 bytes gz, 86 chunks; this branch rebased onto it = 704,846, 89 chunks. The branch costs +4,410 (+4,461 against 90257f8 an hour earlier: the per-chunk split below held across three rebases). GIVEN BACK FIRST, -2,560: the Library's package converters (`package-zip.ts`) and the import funnel (`library/import-parsed.ts`) had landed on this route through `asset-bundle.ts` and `Library.tsx`; every caller is already async, so both load on first use, as do the engine-class reservation list (`reserved-classes.generated.js`, ~5 KB raw) and the backup-restore renames. WHAT REMAINS, attributed per chunk on an earlier pair: shipped-name reservation (`library/reserved-names.ts` with the stage catalog's component names and the selector rename, net ~+1.2 KB), the `.lattice` package carry and its open path (import first, then point the deck at the saved names, so opening a file never overwrites your Library; ~+1.9 KB with the toasts), the finish presets generated from `lib/finishes//` (~+0.8 KB), a saved finish's CSS regenerated from its recipe on read (so finishes saved before the print fix get it), and the zip caps (~+0.4 KB). Not given back: the reservation runs on every save and the filters on every render of the saved-theme menu, and the open path runs when a file is opened, so all of it has to be here when the Studio boots. SET TIGHT (+1,104 over the reading), the convention the entries below use rather than the ~3% in _units. PRIOR: 700600 -> 701500 (2026-09-24): the Studio preview and the Playground splitter walk the ENGINE'S section walker (followup 2329-p2). MEASURED AS A PAIR on one tree, root bundles and docs rebuilt for each reading, and RE-MEASURED ON THE MERGED TREE after #2335 landed under this branch: origin/main 2d8b858 (its sources checked out in place) = 699,593 bytes gz, 85 chunks; this branch rebased onto it = 700,419, 86 chunks. The branch costs +826 (the first reading, on fdd3cdd before the rebase, was 699,552 -> 700,332, +780). Attributed at the source: `split-sections.mjs` and its tokenizer `top-level-h2.mjs` are now imported directly by `slice-equivalence-core.mjs` and `preview-virtual.js`, where the route already carried a bundled copy inside authoring-core.generated.js, so Vite emits them as one more shared chunk; plus `unclosedSectionAt`, the kernel helper both refusal guards and the Playground split now key on. Offset by the Studio's local `maskInert` mask, deleted. NOT GIVEN BACK: the local mask was a second reading of the document (HARD RULE #1), it could not see a section tag inside a quoted attribute, and on that shape the Studio painted "This preview couldn't render" over an ordinary slide (reproduced on the old production build by docs/e2e/studio-section-walk-traps.spec.ts). Deduplicating the authoring-core copy would need that generated bundle to leave the walker external, which its esbuild entry cannot do with a path that resolves from both tools/ and docs/src/playground/. SET TIGHT, +1,081 over the merged reading, this route's convention. PRIOR: 699400 -> 700600 (2026-09-24): every section walker reads a quoted section tag as TEXT (PR #2329). MEASURED AS A PAIR on one tree, root bundles and docs rebuilt for each reading: origin/main 37ed181 (after #2328) = 698,659 bytes gz, 85 chunks; this branch rebased onto it = 699,518 (+859), chunk count unchanged. #2329 first raised this route on its own base (+603, main at 695,587), then #2328 landed and raised the same field, so that raise was dropped in the rebase and this one is set on the MERGED tree instead. studio._htmlRawNote: 201600 -> 202600 (2026-09-20): the same Read · Article view. Measured twice off one tree: 201434 bytes without the shell wiring, 201561 with it — +127, and all of it the two extra chunks' modulepreload hints. The pre-paint shell in studio.astro is UNTOUCHED, which is why this is 127 bytes rather than the thousands a new header control costs — the view is reached from the command palette, which already renders. WORTH KNOWING: this route sat at 166 bytes of headroom BEFORE this change, so the 39 bytes it would otherwise have left is pre-existing tightness, not something this feature created. Unlike eagerJsGz this metric does NOT drift by toolchain (see the components entry), so the local number is authoritative. Set to measured + ~1KB rather than the ~3% in _units, for the reason the eagerJsGz note above gives. PRIOR: 192800 -> 201600 (2026-09-06): the pre-paint shell gained the editor toolbar it had been missing. It drew ONE placeholder pill where the hydrated app draws eleven controls (Add slide, Reshape slide, Fix all issues, Version history, Slide settings, the Markdown/Compose segment, Collapse editor) plus the preview bar's step buttons and a real Reader-view trigger, so the whole band under the header filled in and GREW at hand-off. Those controls' inline lucide glyphs are the bytes. It spends more than the duplicate tail this same PR deleted gave back: measured 195679 on this tree, against 187218 with the tail deleted and the toolbar still missing — so this PR is net +8461 bytes on the route, not the -6182 the previous ratchet recorded. Both numbers are same-tree measurements from the docs build; the pre-PR figure was not re-measured here. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See engineering/decisions/2026-09-05-studio-one-header.md. PRIOR: 199200 -> 192800 (2026-09-05): the pre-paint shell lost a whole duplicate header tail. It drew TWO of them — one for the desktop Read/Write "slim" header and one for Craft — because the app itself rendered two headers; the app renders one now, so the shell draws one, and the second tail's inline lucide glyphs (search, theme, mode, tours, Present, Share, feedback, menu) plus the Read-only deck-title twin left the document. Measured 187218 bytes on this tree. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See engineering/decisions/2026-09-05-studio-one-header.md. PRIOR: 192900 -> 199200 (2026-09-01): auto-split enrolled `content`, `list-criteria` and `journey`, and the Studio inlines the component catalog, so their three new `capacity` blocks ship in this route's HTML. Measured exactly, by building this route twice off one tree: 192397 bytes with main's manifests, 193414 with these — +1017, all of it the three blocks, nothing else in the change reaching this route. Not given back, because giving it back means un-enrolling the components: `content` is the commonest slide in any deck and could not split at all. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. See engineering/decisions/2026-09-01-autosplit-splits-on-structure.md. PRIOR: 185400 -> 192900 (2026-08-19), the pre-paint shell's Craft activity rail filled with the app's own launchers (7.3KB of inline lucide glyphs); see 2026-08-09-studio-shell-structural-completeness.md.

components._htmlRawNote: 522800 -> 538600 (2026-09-13): one new chart component, `heatmap`. This route inlines the WHOLE component catalog, so it carries the component's full docs body — slots table, variants, when to use, anti-patterns, common mistakes — not just the manifest summary the playground shows. Measured the same way as the entry below, twice off one tree: 515970 bytes with `lib/components/chart/heatmap` moved aside, 522867 with it present — +6897, right on the ~7KB-per-component rate the Cartesian seven set. Not given back, because giving it back means shipping the component without the authoring contract this route exists to carry. Set to measured + ~3% per _units above. WORTH KNOWING: 6897 bytes blew a budget that nominally had ~15KB of headroom, because most of that headroom was already spent. The route measured 507617 when the budget below was set (2026-09-06) and measures 515970 today WITHOUT this component — so ~8.4KB arrived in between, from changes that each fit inside the 3% and none of which this PR made. A budget with 3% headroom absorbs drift silently until one change finds the wall, and the change that finds it is not the one that spent the room. Unlike eagerJsGz, this metric does NOT drift by toolchain: the local build reads 522867 and CI reported the same 510.6KB, so a local measurement is authoritative here.
